scripts.dev: bun run scripts/tools.ts && bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.build: bun run scripts/tools.ts && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.smoke: bun run scripts/tools.ts && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.dom-test.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings apps packages scripts e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.scan: bun run scan:dependencies && bun run scan:secrets
scripts.imports:check: bun run imports -- apps packages scripts e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.check:fast: bun run scripts/tools.ts && bun run format:check && bun run lint
scripts.check: bun run check:fast && bun run scripts/boundaries.ts && bun run imports:check && bun run unused && bun run links:check && bun run types:check && bun run lint:workflows && bun run renovate:check && bun test && bun run coverage:scope && bun run typecheck
